status.evidence: According to UK Companies House, FFAVS LTD (company number 10729843) is currently listed as an active private limited company.

claims.claim: The company reports its AI camera data, driver behavior scoring, and fatigue monitoring are integrated directly into the Webfleet platform interface via a strategic partnership with Bridgestone Webfleet.
The company reports a software integration with CO3 designed to expand fleet data visibility and utility across commercial transport operations.

The company reports offering onboard hardware including AI-powered fleet dashcams, 360-degree multi-camera systems, remote tachographs, and BLE asset tracking tags for tools, plant, and trailers, as detailed in its product specifications on Fleet Focus Terms of Use.
The company utilizes AES-256 encryption for cloud data at rest and TLS 1.2 / 1.3 protocols for telematics media in transit, as stated in the Fleet Focus Privacy Policy.

The company automates HGV fleet compliance through secure, GDPR-compliant cloud archiving featuring an automatic 14-day data deletion cycle on its video telematics platform, as detailed in its product documentation.

Fleet Focus (FFAVS Ltd) completed an outbound API integration with CO3 in September 2026, allowing customers to share live GPS tracking and telematics data with third-party Transport Management Systems (TMS) and delivery platforms.
Fleet Focus partnered with Quartix to deploy an API-based camera system integration that embeds its MyFleetLive HD event footage directly into the Quartix tracking interface.

London-based waste management company Westminster Waste deployed Fleet Focus's AI Powered Fleet Dashcams, AI Powered Multicamera DVR Systems, and DVS 2024 Radar Systems to streamline accident reporting, according to a case study published by Fleet Focus.

UK logistics network Advanced Proteins deployed Fleet Focus's 3DA AI Dashcams, ADAS/DSM cameras, and GPS tracking to automate incident resolution and monitor driver behavior, according to a case study published by Fleet Focus.
The company reports a revenue figure of 7,697,444.0 according to financial data tracked by GlobalDatabase.com.

The company reports in its operational policies that it operates on a business-to-business (B2B) distribution framework working directly with business partners including Telematics Service Providers (TSPs) and Resellers.
FFAVS Ltd operates out of its primary physical facility located at 6 Kings Court, Newcomen Way, Severalls Industrial Park, Colchester, United Kingdom.
claims.source: UK Companies House and Fleet Focus Contact Page

claims.claim: The company maintains a regional headcount of 22 employees to support its commercial fleet telematics business operations.
